### Grace for God's Adulterous Bride
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/grace-gods-adulterous-bride
Passage: Ezekiel 16:60
Points:
- Marriage illustrates the sacred relationship God entered into with His chosen people.
- Israel persistently betrayed the Lord through spiritual adultery, worshiping idols and pursuing worldly alliances.
- God gave Israel over to the consequences of her sin so she would experience its shame and futility.
- The Lord's judgment was restorative, intended to lead His people to genuine repentance.
- Despite their unfaithfulness, God promised to remember His covenant and establish an everlasting covenant fulfilled in Christ.
